| Scope | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Inputs | Repository configurations; all platform variants |
| Bindings | Configured declarations, including removals and conditional alternatives |
| Defaults | Inherited application/plugin defaults are not expanded |
| Lua | Static syntax parsing; literal loops expanded; unresolved expressions retained |
| Conditions | Source conditions and callback scopes; no application code executed |
| Descriptions | Explicit descriptions, then action names or source expressions |
| Sources | File and line links; edits belong in the configuration |
